products.body_html:
AIR 5400 LX-R RGB iCUE LINK Triple Chamber Mid-Tower PC Case

Triple-chamber design for peak thermal performance

Dedicated chamber for CPU cooling

Dual airflow ducts for powerful main chamber airflow

Dual curved glass French door panels

Compatible with reverse connector motherboards

RapidRoute 2.0 cable management system

3x iCUE LINK LX-R RGB 120mm reverse-rotor fans and System Hub

TRIPLE-CHAMBER DESIGN

A unique triple-chamber design was created to isolate hot components for effective cooling and maximum performance at all times. Separate chambers for the CPU, GPU/motherboard, and PSU, cables, and storage allow for exceptional thermals and an easy PC building process.

POWERFUL GPU AIRFLOW

The roomy interior was designed specifically for the most powerful GPUs with plenty of room to breathe and dual airflow ducts to channel cool air through the GPU for maximum performance.

REVERSE-ROTOR iCUE LINK LX-R FANS

Preinstalled reverse-rotor iCUE LINK LX-R RGB 120mm fans in the bottom of the chassis allow for efficient, low-noise cooling with glorious, unobstructed RGB lighting.

The included System Hub supports up to 24 iCUE LINK devices, so you can easily power any additional iCUE LINK fans with just one cable.

DUAL CURVED GLASS FRENCH DOOR PANELS

Two glass panels connect in the corner of the chassis and open outwards with hinges that disappear for a seamless look and easy access to your hardware.

RAPIDROUTE 2.0

Cable management has never been easier with RapidRoute 2.0. It features a new pegboard motherboard tray so you can easily move and rotate cable ties wherever you like for a tidy build.

WIDE COOLING FLEXIBILITY

The AIR 5400 includes 3x 120mm reverse-rotor intake fans in the bottom, with room for 7x more in the CPU chamber, roof, and rear exhaust for highly effective airflow in both chambers.

MODERN FRONT PANEL I/O

Puts your connections within easy reach, including a USB 3.2 Gen 2x2 Type-C port with 20Gb/s of bandwidth, 2x USB 3.2 Gen 1 Type-C ports with 5Gb/s of bandwidth, and a combination audio/microphone jack.

1. USB 3.2 Gen 2 Type-C Port

2. 2x USB 3.2 Gen 1 Type-C Ports

products.body_html:
FRAME 4500X LX-R RGB iCUE LINK Panoramic Glass Mid-Tower PC Case

Single-piece curved glass front and side panel

InfiniRail™ Fan Mounting System for easier building

Dual 360mm radiator support

3x iCUE LINK LX-R RGB 120mm reverse-rotor fans

GPU Anti-sag Stabilization Arm

Compatible with reverse connector motherboards

iCUE LINK System Hub included for full digital control of connected devices

PANORAMIC GLASS SIDE PANEL

A single-piece of curved tempered glass lets you show off your build uninhibited, without any seams or sharp angles blocking the view. The curved glass wraps around the front and side, providing an unobstructed view of your high-powered hardware.

The tempered glass side panel is laminated with a practically invisible film coating for safety and noise reduction.

CORSAIR INFINIRAIL™ FAN MOUNTING SYSTEM

This steel multi-point fan mounting system provides unmatched flexibility for the roof fan configuration. Easily slide the rail to mount either 120mm or 140mm fans exactly where you need it, ensuring targeted airflow without the limitation of fixed mounting points.

LX-R REVERSE-ROTOR INTAKE FANS INCLUDED

Reverse-rotor iCUE LINK LX-R RGB intake fans offer easy one-cable connectivity, unobstructed RGB lighting, and low-noise cooling. Fresh air is pulled through the ventilated side and into the spacious mid-tower chassis for effective cooling and plenty of airflow to ensure maximum performance.

A color-matched iCUE LINK System Hub is included so it’s easy to add more LINK fans to your system, with support for up to 24 devices on just one hub.

VENTILATED SIDE AND TOP PANELS

Airflow optimized panels adorn the top and side of the FRAME 4500X to provide maximum breathability for fans mounted in both locations.

The side-mounted reverse-rotor intake fans pull cool air in from outside the chassis, while top-mounted fans (sold separately) exhaust hot air out of the case to keep the interior frosty.

LOOK, NO CABLES

Fully compatible with ASUS BTF, MSI Project Zero, and GIGABYTE Project Stealth, this design features ample connector and cable cutouts, along with tie-downs to keep your build neat and organized, even where you can’t see them.

WIDE COOLING FLEXIBILITY

Customize your cooling setup with room for up to 10x 120mm fans, plus versatile radiator mounting options including up to 2x 360mm radiators at the same time.
